episodeName: AIOS memory is local-first with Graphiti outbox
episodeBody:
type: decision
project: aios
agent: codex
createdAt: 2026-05-22T11:50:01.000Z
tags: memory, graphiti, architecture

Use a local-first AIOS memory layer with JSONL events, facts, decisions, Markdown summaries, and a Graphiti-ready outbox before relying on external memory services.

rationale:
The AIOS already uses file-based memory and must remain usable across Codex, Claude, Gemini, Jarvis, and local scripts even when Graphiti or external services are offline.
